

// package main






type Void = u8;

fn make_flat( ) -> (Void) {
    
        

return 1u8;



    
}
fn make_record( ) -> (Void) {
    
        

return 2u8;



    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let flat = make_flat()
;


let record = make_record()
;


let closure_flat = || -> (Void) {
  
    

return 3u8;



  
}
;


let closure_record = || -> (Void) {
  
    

return 4u8;



  
}
;


let third = closure_flat()
;


let fourth = closure_record()
;



let _: Void = flat; let _: Void = record; let _: Void = third; let _: Void = fourth; assert_eq!((flat, record, third, fourth), (1, 2, 3, 4));



    
}
